departments.pageDescription: The departments a profile can belong to
departments.subtitle: The people screen offers these as a dropdown, so a department added here is available immediately when adding or editing an account.
departments.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
departments.empty: No departments yet. Add one to be able to place people in it.
departments.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from the list of departments.
departments.deleteInUse: Move everyone out of this department first — deleting it would leave them without one.

errors.load: The department list could not be loaded.
errors.duplicate: A department with that name already exists. Names are case-sensitive, so check the spelling.
errors.create: The department could not be created. Please try again.
errors.delete: The department could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.inUse: {name} still has {count} person/people in it. Move them to another department first.

positions.pageDescription: The job titles a person on the handover roster can hold
positions.subtitle: The Add User tab in Asset Settings offers these as a dropdown, so a position added here is available immediately when adding someone to the handover roster.
positions.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
positions.empty: No positions yet. Add the job titles your company actually uses before adding anyone to the handover roster.
positions.created: {name} was added to the position list.
positions.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from the list of positions.
positions.deleteInUse: Move everyone holding this position first — deleting it would leave them without one.

errors.load: The position list could not be loaded.
errors.duplicate: A position with that name already exists. Names are case-sensitive, so check the spelling.
errors.save: The position could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.delete: The position could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.inUse: {name} is still held by {count} person/people. Move them to another position first.

assetSettings.pageDescription: The categories and locations the asset form offers
assetSettings.subtitle: The asset screen reads these tables for its dropdowns, so anything added here is available immediately when adding or editing an asset.
assetSettings.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
assetSettings.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from the list of options.
assetSettings.deleteInUse: Move the things pointing at it first — deleting it would leave them without one.
assetSettings.categoriesHint: A sub-category belongs to one category above it. The code on a category is what the asset form uses to decide which fields to show, so an existing category should not have its code changed casually.
assetSettings.locationsHint: An area is a registered site; a room is a specific place inside it. A location may be just an area, which is why the room can be left empty.
assetSettings.currentLocationsHint: Where an asset physically is right now, as distinct from where it is registered. Same area-and-room shape as a location, and the two are chosen separately on the asset form, so an asset registered at one site and sitting in another room is recorded rather than guessed.
assetSettings.emptyForDepartment: No categories for {name} yet. Add the first one below.
assetSettings.currentLocationCreated: {name} was added as a current location.
assetSettings.handoverUsersHint: People an asset can be handed over to. A handover can go to somebody with no account at all; linking an account only lets that person see and return their own handovers in the app.
assetSettings.handoverUsersEmpty: No handover user yet. Add the people assets are handed to before issuing a handover.
assetSettings.handoverUserCreated: {name} was added to the handover list.
assetSettings.handoverUserDeleted: {name} was removed from the handover list.
assetSettings.deleteHandoverUserInUse: This person appears on handover records. Return or reassign those before removing them.

fields.name: Name
fields.departmentHint: Which unit owns this category. A sub-category always belongs to the same department as its parent, and two departments may each have a category with the same name.
fields.noParent: None — this is a main category
fields.parentHint: Leave empty for a main category. A sub-category's parent decides which fields the asset form shows.
fields.codeHint: The asset form switches its fields on this. Leave empty and the asset form falls back to the common fields; it is not available for a sub-category.
fields.roomHint: Leave empty when the location is a whole area rather than a room inside one.
fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth recording about this location
fields.handoverUserDepartmentHint: Leave empty if this person has no department. This is a person’s department, so it offers every department rather than only the two asset units.
fields.handoverUserAccountHint: Optional. Link an account only if this person also signs in — it is what lets them see and return their own handovers. Leave empty for a contractor or a visitor.
fields.handoverUserNotesPlaceholder: Anything worth recording about this person
fields.handoverUserPositionHint: Pick from the Position list in User Management. Add a new title there first — this dropdown only offers positions that already exist, so a misspelling here would become a position of its own.
fields.noPositionsYet: There are no positions yet. Add one from User Management → Position before adding someone to the handover roster.

errors.load: The reference data could not be loaded.
errors.save: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.delete: The entry could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.duplicate: An entry with that name already exists. Names are case-sensitive, so check the spelling.
errors.duplicateInUnit: This department already has a category with that name. Another department may still use the same name.
errors.crossDepartment: A sub-category must belong to the same department as its parent. Pick a parent from the department selected above.
errors.moveWithChildren: This category still has sub-categories, so it cannot move to another department on its own. Move or clear them first.
errors.categoryInUse: This category still has {subCategories} sub-categor(y/ies) and {assets} asset(s) pointing at it. Move them first.
errors.locationInUse: This location still has {count} asset(s) pointing at it. Move them first.
errors.currentLocationInUse: This current location still has {count} asset(s) pointing at it. Move them first.
errors.handoverUserPositionRequired: Choose a position. Add new job titles from the Position list in User Management.
errors.handoverUserInUse: This person still appears on {count} handover record(s). Return or reassign them before removing the person.

users.pageDescription: Review the accounts in this workspace, and add or edit them
users.subtitle: Adding an account sets a first password here, so tell it to the person directly. They will be asked to choose their own the first time they sign in.
users.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or department
users.deleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with.
users.deleteOnlyAccount: This is the only account in the workspace. Add another administrator before deleting this one.
users.deleteBody: {name} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
users.deleteWarningTitle: This also loses, with no way to recover them:
users.deleteWarningLoans: the record of which admin issued each handover this account created. The handovers themselves stay: the person who received an asset is named in the User Handover roster, not in the login list, so deleting an account no longer erases loan history
users.deleteWarningLender: this person’s own link to their account, so they stop seeing and returning their own handovers in the app. The roster entry stays and an admin can relink it to a new account
users.deleteWarningAssets: nothing else — assets are untouched, because a handover is not removed when the account that issued it is
users.deleteDoneWithLoans: {name} was deleted, along with the record of {count} handover(s) they had issued. The handovers themselves are kept.
users.resetBody: {name} will sign in with the password you set here. Give it to them directly — there is no email to send it to.
users.resetPrompt: They will be asked to choose their own password the first time they sign in.
users.resetFlagFailed: The password for {name} was reset, but their account was not marked as needing a new one. They will not be asked to change it — so pass on the password you set, and expect them to keep it.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The person signs in with this, so tell it to them.
users.emailManagedElsewhere: The email address is changed in Supabase, not here.
users.lastAdminOnlyAccount: You are the only account here. Add another administrator first — that is the only way to hand over, and it is the reason this is disabled.
users.lastAdmin: This is the only administrator. Promote somebody else first.
users.selfWarning: This is your own account. You will lose access to this page as soon as the change is saved.
users.noDepartmentsYet: No departments yet — add one from the Department page first.

errors.partial: The account was created, but its department and role did not save. Close this and edit them from the list.
errors.passwordFlagFailed: The account was created, but it was not marked as needing a new password. That person will not be asked to change it — so pass on the password you set, and expect them to keep it.

pageDescription.IT: The IT asset inventory: what exists, what it is, and where it is.
pageDescription.HSSE: The HSSE inventory: equipment, its expiry date, and when it was last and is next inspected.

subtitle.IT: Stock belongs to everyone, so this list is readable by every signed-in user. Only admins can change it.
subtitle.HSSE: Same read access as Asset IT — stock belongs to everyone. Only admins can change it.

assets.empty: No assets have been recorded yet.
assets.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its credential row goes with it. This is refused if the asset is still on loan or has any maintenance record, so that history cannot be lost by accident.

fields.hsseHint: These four are what the spreadsheet does not cover and what an HSSE item always has. Network and credentials are not shown for this unit at all, and usage status stays hidden because its values describe how a computer is lent out.
fields.registerHint: The schedule and paperwork this item is inspected against. Frequency and unit are one answer: clear either and both go. The register's Equipment Family is not asked for here, because it is the category you pick in the Identity tab.
fields.name: Name
fields.isLabeledHint: Whether the physical label has been printed and stuck on the device.
fields.credentialsWarning: Stored as plain text. Readable by admins only, but not encrypted — if that matters, keep the real credential in a password manager and leave these boxes empty.
fields.credentialsHint: Leave both boxes empty to remove the stored credential.
fields.protocolUrlHint: Stored on the asset itself, which every signed-in user can read. Do not put a username or password in this URL — a credential belongs in the Credentials tab.
fields.usageStatusHint: The spreadsheet's own field, recorded as written there. It is not changed automatically: "Lent out" overlaps the loan status above, and the loan triggers never read this column.

errors.save: Could not save the asset. Please try again.
errors.delete: Could not delete the asset. Please try again.
errors.priceInvalid: The purchase price has to be a number.
errors.portsInvalid: Each port count has to be a whole number, or left empty.
errors.duplicateCode: That asset code is already used by another asset.
errors.statusContradictsLoans: That status disagrees with the current loans, so the database refused it. An asset out on loan is Assigned on its own.
errors.inUse: {name} cannot be deleted: it still has {assignments} loan record(s) and {maintenance} maintenance record(s). Returning it and clearing its history is the only way to remove it.

handover.pageDescription: Hand assets over to people and record what comes back.
handover.subtitle: Every handover an asset goes out on, and whether it has come back.
handover.empty: No {unit} asset has been handed over yet.
handover.deleteBody: The record is removed. The asset itself is not affected.
handover.deleteOpenHint: This handover is still open. Return the asset before deleting the record.

fields.assetsHint: {count} selected. Handing over several assets at once creates one handover record per asset, all to the same person. Nothing is saved unless every selected asset can be handed over.
fields.docPlaceholder: This asset has no document number
fields.docReadOnlyHint: Taken from the asset record, where it is edited. A handover does not change it, so every handover of this asset prints the same number.
fields.personHint: Pick from the User Handover list in Asset Settings, not from the login list. The account you are signed in as is recorded as who issued this handover.
fields.recordedBy: This handover will be recorded under

errors.pickers: The asset and person lists could not be loaded, so nothing can be issued from here.
errors.notAvailable: That asset is not available to hand over. It may be retired, damaged, already out, or in maintenance.
errors.alreadyHandedOver: That asset was handed to somebody else first. Reload and try again.
errors.issue: The handover could not be saved.
errors.returnDenied: That handover could not be returned. You may only return one you are holding.
errors.open: This handover is still open, so deleting it would put the asset back into stock while the person still has it. Return it first.
errors.delete: The handover could not be deleted.
errors.notAvailableNamed: Nothing was saved, because {assets} is no longer available to hand over. It may have been handed to somebody else while this form was open. Reload and pick again.
